# Nikkei spotlights Burford Capital and patent monetization opportunities in Japan


- Patent & IP


December 1, 2025


-
-
-
-


*Nikkei* discusses[patent monetization](https://www.burfordcapital.com/campaigns/burford-ip-monetization/) opportunities for Japanese companies, as well as the evolution of patent litigation in the age of AI, with CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) .


"'There is strong demand from companies and universities to monetize patents, and growth is expected,'" says Bogart.
